_comment: If Long Shot has an aim counter, it has +2{p}. WHILE_STATIC re-evaluates on every RECALC_ATTACK_POWER so the bonus appears/disappears as aim counters are added/removed. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack. COUNTER_GTE with counter_type 'aim' and amount 1 checks for at least one aim counter (release note: multiple aim counters do not give multiple instances). MODIFY_ATTACK under a recalc event applies transiently in the stage-8 window without accumulating. Printed_keywords is empty so no conditional-keyword machinery needed.
